project_type: Python 3 CLI package (deepresearch) - bot #1 of a faith-content video pipeline; produces a sourced research dossier (JSON + Markdown) around a 'common misconception vs. deeper truth' spine.
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml; editable install `pip install -e '.[dev]'`. A .venv built with 3.12 already exists at /projects/sandbox/Tournament/.venv.
test_framework: pytest. tests/conftest.py is an autouse guard that unsets OPENAI_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and monkeypatches the default live HTTP getter to RAISE, so any real network call fails the suite. Connectors are built with an offline cache. 54 tests currently pass.
build_command: .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'  (already installed; re-run only if deps change)
verification_instructions: From /projects/sandbox/Tournament run: `unset OPENAI_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_API_KEY && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q`. Must pass with zero network and zero keys. pytest is the required runner (unittest discover will NOT collect the function/parametrize tests). Optionally spot-check dry-run: `.venv/bin/python -m deepresearch research "judge not" --dry-run --output-dir /tmp/dr` and inspect the JSON/MD.
snapshot_or_generated_files: output/ and .cache/ are generated and git-ignored. No checked-in generated/snapshot files. deepresearch.egg-info is build metadata (ignore).
setup_instructions: Interpreter MUST be the 3.12 venv (`/projects/sandbox/Tournament/.venv/bin/python`); the default python3 on PATH is 3.9 and must NOT be used. Dev deps already installed via `.venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'`.
environment_constraints: NO outbound network and NO API keys. Everything added must work and be tested fully offline from bundled fixtures. All data added must be strictly PUBLIC DOMAIN (Strong's, KJV/WEB/ASV, public-domain Church Fathers/commentary). Do NOT touch /projects/sandbox/Autosurveryai or /projects/sandbox/Tourament.
contribution_requirements: Work on branch feat/deep-research-agent (rolls into open PR #1). Add commits on top; do NOT push, merge, or open a new PR (orchestrator pushes afterward). schema_version is 0.1.0 and should stay 0.1.0 if the only schema change is ADDITIVE/backward-compatible (new OPTIONAL field); if bumped, update deepresearch/__init__.py SCHEMA_VERSION and every assertion in lockstep. No secrets; .env.example stays placeholder-only.
key_patterns: KEY LOOKUP SEMANTICS (critical): (1) topic queries - fetch_translations uses anchors from fixtures/topic_anchors.json (resolve_topic_anchors matches keys whitespace-collapsed + lowercased, so topic_anchors.json keys should be lowercase and may map to a LIST of anchors, de-duped downstream); (2) extract_original_terms + gather_context + gather_cross_references key strongs.json/commentary.json by the RAW query string for a topic (NOT normalized/lowercased) and by the normalized reference for a verse query - so topic fixtures must be keyed by the EXACT phrasing a test/user passes; (3) bible_api fixture fallback (_fixture_body) looks up verses.json by the ORIGINAL single-verse reference (e.g. 'Matthew 7:1'), not the context-window-expanded passage, so verses.json keyed by the single verse works for dry-run. Connectors never raise: they return SourceResult.missing(name, reason) -> recorded as a Gap -> graceful degradation. Fixtures are plain JSON loaded via deepresearch/fixtures/__init__.py::load_fixture (lru_cached). Stub provider templates spine prose from gathered material (commentary excerpt / historical note), so neutrality check must not false-positive on neutral boilerplate OR on the seeded public-domain commentary text. Integrity check (synthesis.py) resolves every claim citation back to gathered material; the stub reuses only brief citations. Adversarial fake-provider test pattern lives in tests/test_integrity.py (subclass LLMProvider, return crafted JSON from complete()).
relevant_files: deepresearch/fixtures/topic_anchors.json (A: grow map; currently 1 entry; keys lowercase; values = list of anchor refs)
